headline: Why is commitment still uncertain after all these years?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the picture, but your hand found the card where everything is prepared.
The full set of tools is arranged across his table.
You asked why commitment remains uncertain after all these years. The prepared table is the part I keep coming back to.
The relationship has years behind it, and the commitment remains uncertain.
Something sits between what is already prepared and the named future. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave no hint, yet you reached for the one held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him hangs loose.
You asked why the future is still suspended. This card brings me to the single restraint.
Still, the future is held while the rest of the relationship continues.
Whatever has hold of the commitment keeps one question apart from the rest. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the commitment…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed you the card, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
The small bundle remains on his stick as he moves.
You asked why commitment has not settled. The bundle moving forward holds my eye.
But the years have moved, and the commitment has not settled with them.
Something appears right where the shared road would settle into commitment. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
